evals.name: smoke-full-audit-routes-to-methodology-and-fix-prompt
evals.prompt: Audit this marketing site for SEO issues from the codebase, tell me what is broken around canonicals, OG tags, and schema, and then give me a prompt I can hand to another session to fix everything.
evals.expected_output: Uses the methodology, performs a technical and metadata review, and produces a second-session implementation prompt instead of generic SEO advice.

assertions.text: Response starts with repository and page-type analysis rather than framework assumptions
Response covers canonicals, OG tags, and schema distinctly
Response includes a structured handoff prompt for another session

evals.name: edge-case-intentional-noindex-pages-are-not-flagged-as-errors
evals.prompt: Check the repo's SEO, but note that account, cart, checkout, and internal search routes are intentionally noindexed. Focus on real mistakes only.
evals.expected_output: Keeps intentional noindex rules out of the critical findings and focuses on true index-worthy pages.

assertions.text: Response distinguishes intentional exclusions from accidental ones
Response does not recommend indexing account or checkout pages by default

evals.name: negative-link-building-request-does-not-trigger-cleanly
evals.prompt: I need 100 backlink ideas and outreach email copy to raise domain authority fast.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that this skill is for on-site code and content analysis, not off-page link building or outreach.

assertions.text: Response does not force a codebase SEO audit onto an outreach request
Response identifies off-page SEO as out of scope for this skill

evals.name: disclosure-social-preview-question-loads-preview-reference
evals.prompt: Why do link previews break even though the title tag looks fine? Check OG tags, twitter cards, favicon, and preview image behavior.
evals.expected_output: Loads the metadata and previews reference and separates search metadata from social metadata.

assertions.text: Agent reads references/metadata-and-previews.md
Response checks OG tags and social card fields directly
Response explains that search metadata and social metadata are related but distinct

evals.name: scoped-offline-canonical-answer-without-handoff
evals.prompt: Offline review only: inspect the canonical helper and tell me in three bullets whether /docs pagination is handled correctly. Do not create files or an implementation prompt, and leave intentional noindex pages alone.
evals.expected_output: Returns a focused source-only answer with evidence and runtime limitations, without expanding to a full report or generating a handoff.

assertions.text: Answers in three bullets without report files, helper execution, or a fix prompt
Cites relevant source evidence, labels deployed behavior unverified, and preserves intentional noindex
Does not guarantee ranking or AI-answer visibility from the proposed change

evals.name: valid-schema-without-rich-result-eligibility
evals.prompt: Our FAQPage JSON-LD is valid schema.org and matches visible questions and answers, but the current official Google feature policy says this site is ineligible for FAQ rich results. Should we remove it as misleading? We also have an AggregateRating with no real reviews.
evals.expected_output: Separates vocabulary validity from Google feature eligibility, does not remove truthful markup merely for ineligibility, and flags the unsupported rating facts.

assertions.text: Distinguishes truthful valid FAQ markup from current Google rich-result eligibility without promising display
Flags fabricated or unsupported rating data rather than treating all non-eligible markup as misleading

evals.name: handoff-revalidates-changed-state-and-evidence
evals.prompt: Prepare a fix-session prompt from last month's SEO audit. The layout has since changed, one finding says 'No evidence provided', and checkout noindex must remain. Avoid repeating the whole audit.
evals.expected_output: Reuses relevant evidence but requires revalidation of changed state, keeps unsupported findings unconfirmed, and preserves implementation constraints.

assertions.text: Requires targeted revalidation before edits instead of forbidding all repeated investigation
Does not present placeholder evidence as a confirmed issue or turn it into an unconditional fix
Carries the intentional checkout noindex constraint into the handoff

evals.name: stale-baseline-proposes-canonical-update
evals.prompt: The bundled structured-data guidance conflicts with the current official Google policy supplied with this audit. Resolve the recommendation for this site; do not modify installed skills or invent a search benefit.
evals.expected_output: Uses the relevant current official policy and site evidence, states the dated baseline limitation, and proposes rather than silently applies a canonical skill update.

assertions.text: Identifies the exact stale passage and current official source/version or retrieval date
Proposes a canonical repository correction with an example or regression test without changing the installed skill
Does not invent ranking or AI-visibility guarantees
